Engero za Sulemaani mutabani wa Dawudi, kabaka wa Isiraeri:
Okumanyanga amagezi n'okuyigirizibwanga; Okwawulanga ebigambo eby'okutegeera;
Okukkiriza okuyigirizibwanga okukolanga eby'amagezi, Obutuukirivu n'okusalanga emisango n'okugobereranga ensonga;
Okuwanga abatalina magezi obukabakaba, Omulenzi abeerenga n'okumanya n'okuteesa:
Ow'amagezi awulire yeeyongerenga okuba n'okuyiga; Era omusajja alina okutegeera afune okuteesanga okutuufu.
Okutegeeranga olugero n'ekifaananyi; Ebigambo eby'abagezigezi n'ebikokko byabwe.
Mu kutya Mukama okumanya mwe kusookera: Naye abasirusiru banyooma amagezi n'okuyigirizibwanga.
Mwana wange, wulira okuyigirizanga kwa kitaawo, So tova mu tteeka lya nnyoko:
Kubanga binaabanga ngule ya kisa ku mutwe gwo, N'emikuufu egyetoolodde obulago bwo.
Mwana wange, abalina ebibi bwe bakusendasenda, Tokkirizanga.
Bwe boogera nti Jjangu tugende fenna, Tuteege omusaayi, Tugwire mu kyama ataliiko musango awatali nsonga;
Tubamire nga bakyali balamu ng'amagombe, Era nga bakyali balamba ng'abo abakka mu bunnya;
Tuliraba ebintu byonna eby'omuwendo omungi. Tulijjuza ennyumba zaffe omunyago;
Oneekubira akalulu wamu naffe; Fenna tunaabanga n'ensawo emu:
Mwana wange, totambuliranga mu kkubo wamu nabo: Ziyizanga ekigere kyo okuyitanga mu lugendo lwabwe:
Kubanga ebigere byabwe bidduka mbiro okugoberera obubi, Era byanguwa okuyiwa omusaayi.
Kubanga bategera bwereere ekitimba, Ennyonyi yonna ng'ekiraba:
Era abo bateega omusaayi gwabwe bo, Bagwira mu kyama obulamu bwabwe bo.
Bwe gatyo bwe gabeera amakubo aga buli muntu eyeegomba amagoba; Gaggyawo obulamu bwa bannyini go.
Amagezi googerera waggulu mu luguudo; Galeeta eddoboozi lyago mu bifo ebigazi;
Googerera waggulu mu kifo ekikulu eky'okukuŋŋaaniramu; Awayingirirwa mu miryango, Mu kibuga mwe galeetera ebigambo byago:
Mmwe abatalina magezi, mulituusa wa okwagalanga obutaba na magezi? N'abanyooma okusanyukiranga okunyooma, N'abasirusiru okukyawanga okumanya?
Mukyuke olw'okunenya kwange: Laba, naafukanga omwoyo gwange gye muli, Naabamanyisanga ebigambo byange.
Kubanga mpise, mmwe ne mugaana; Ngolodde omukono gwange, so tewali muntu assizzaayo mwoyo;
Naye mujjuludde okuteesa kwange kwonna, So temwagadde kunenya kwange n'akatono:
Era nange ndisekera ku lunaku kwe mulirabira ennaku; Ndikudaala entiisa yammwe bw'erituuka;
Entiisa yammwe bw'erituuka ng'omuyaga, N'ennaku ze muliraba bwe zirijja ng'embuyaga ez'akazimu; Okweraliikirira n'obubalagaze bwe biribajjira.
Kale bwe balinkaabira, naye siriddamu; Balinnoonya nnyo, naye tebalindaba:
Kubanga baakyawanga okumanya, So tebeerobozanga kutya Mukama:
Tebaayagalanga kuteesa kwange n'akatono; Baanyoomanga okunenya kwange kwonna:
Kyebaliva balya ku bibala eby'ekkubo lyabwe bo, Ne bakkuta enkwe zaabwe bo.
Kubanga okudda ennyuma okw'abatalina magezi kulibatta, N'okulaba omukisa okw'abasirusiru kulibazikiriza.
Naye buli anaawuliranga nze anaabeeranga mirembe, Era anaatereeranga nga tewali kutya kabi.
Mwana wange, bw'onokkirizanga ebigambo byange, N'oterekanga ebiragiro byange ewuwo;
N'okutega n'oteganga okutu kwo eri amagezi N'ossangayo omutima gwo eri okutegeera;
Weewaawo, bw'onookaabiranga okumanya, N'oliriranga okutegeera.
Bw'onooganoonyanga nga ffeeza, N'ogakenneenyanga ng'eby'obugagga ebyakwekebwa;
Kale lw'olitegeera okutya Mukama, N'ovumbula okumanya Katonda.
Kubanga Mukama awa amagezi; Mu kamwa ke mwe mufuluma okumanya n'okutegeera:
Aterekera abagolokofu amagezi amatuufu, Aba ngabo eri abo abatambulira mu butayonoona;
Alyoke akuume amakubo ag'omusango, Era awonye okutambula kw'abatukuvu be.
Kale lw'olitegeera obutuukirivu n'omusango, N'eby'ensonga, weewaawo buli kkubo eddungi.
Kubanga amagezi ganaayingiranga mu mutima gwo, N'okumanya kunaawoomeranga emmeeme yo;
Okuteesa kunaakulabiriranga. Okutegeera kunaakukuumanga:
Okukuwonyanga mu kkubo ery'obubi, Eri abasajja aboogera eby'ekyejo;
Abaleka amakubo ag'obugolokofu, Okutambuliranga mu makubo ag'ekizikiza;
Abasanyuka okukola obubi, N'ekyejo eky'omubi kye kibawoomera;
Amakubo gaabwe makyamukyamu, N'okugenda kwabwe kwenyoolanyoola:
Okukuwonyanga eri omukazi omugenyi, Eri omugenyi anyumiriza n'ebigambo bye;
Aleka omukwano ogw'omu buto bwe, Ne yeerabira endagaano ya Katonda we:
Kubanga ennyumba ye etwala mu kufa, N'amakubo ge eri abafu:
Tewali abagenda gy'ali abadda nate, So tebatuuka mu makubo ag'obulamu:
Olyoke otambulirenga mu kkubo ery'abasajja abalungi, N'okwata empenda ez'abatuukirivu.
Kubanga abagolokofu banaabeeranga mu nsi, N'abo abatuukirira balisigala omwo.
Naye ababi balimalibwawo okuva mu nsi, N'abo abasala enkwe balisimbulirwamu ddala.
Mwana wange, teweerabiranga tteeka lyange; Naye omutima gwo gukwatenga ebiragiro byange;
Kubanga ennaku ennyingi n'emyaka egy'okuwangaala N'emirembe bye birikwongerwako.
Okusaasira n'amazima tebikulekanga: Bisibenga mu bulago bwo; Biwandiikenga ku bipande eby'omutima gwo:
Bw'onoolabanga bw'otyo okuganja n'okutegeera okulungi Mu maaso ga Katonda n'ag'abantu.
Weesigenga Mukama n'omutima gwo gwonna. So teweesigamanga ku kutegeera kwo ggwe:
Mwatulenga mu makubo go gonna, Kale anaaluŋŋamyanga olugendo lwo.
Tobanga na magezi mu maaso go ggwe; Tyanga Mukama ove mu bubi:
Ekyo kye kinaabanga obulamu eri ekkundi lyo, N'obusomyo eri amagumba go.
Ossangamu ekitiibwa Mukama n'ebintu byo, N'ebibereberye ku bibala byo byonna:
Amawanika go bwe ganajjulanga bwe gatyo ekyengera, N'amasogolero go ganaayiikanga omwenge omusu.
Mwana wange, tonyoomanga kubuulirira kwa Mukama; So n'okunenya kwe kulemenga okukukooya:
Kubanga Mukama gw'ayagala gw'anenya; Era nga kitaawe omwana we gw'asanyukira.
Aweereddwa omukisa omuntu alaba amagezi. N'oyo afuna okutegeera.
Kubanga obuguzi bwago businga obuguzi obwa ffeeza, N'amagoba gaago gakira zaabu ennungi.
Ga muwendo mungi okusinga amayinja amatwakaavu: So tewali kintu ky'oyinza okwegomba ebyenkanyankanyizibwa nago.
Okuwangaala kuli mu mukono gwago ogwa ddyo; Mu mukono gwago ogwa kkono mulimu obugagga n'ekitiibwa.
Amakubo gaago makubo ga kusanyukiramu, N'eŋŋendo zaago zonna mirembe.
Ago gwe muti ogw'obulamu eri abo abagakwata: Era alina omukisa buli muntu abeera nago.
Mukama yassaawo emisingi gy'ensi n'amagezi; Yanyweza eggulu n'okutegeera.
Ennyanja yayabika n'okumanya kwe, Eggulu ne litonnya omusulo.
Mwana wange, ebyo tebivanga ku maaso go; Kwatanga amagezi amatuufu n'okuteesa;
Bwe binaabanga bwe bityo obulamu eri emmeeme yo, N'obuyonjo eri obulago bwo.
Awo lw'olitambulira mu kkubo lyo mirembe, So n'ekigere kyo tekiryesittala.
Bw'onoogalamiranga tootyenga: Weewaawo, onoogalamiranga n'otulo two tunaakuwoomeranga.
Totyanga ntiisa gy'otomanyiridde, Newakubadde okuzikiriza okw'ababi bwe kujjanga:
Kubanga Mukama ye anaabanga obwesige bwo, Era ye anaakuumanga ekigere kyo olemenga okuwambibwa
Tommanga birungi abo abagwanira, Bwe kiri mu buyinza bw'omukono gwo okubikola.
Togambanga muliraanwa wo nti Genda okomewo, Enkya ndikuwa; Bwe kiri naawe.
Tosaliranga munno bubi, Kubanga abeera gy'oli mirembe
Toyombanga na muntu awatali nsonga, Oba nga taliiko bubi bw'akukoze.
Tokwatirwanga buggya omusajja ow'amawaggali, So teweerobozanga makubo ge gonna.
Kubanga omukyamu wa muzizo eri Mukama: Naye ekyama kye kiri n'abagolokofu.
Ekikolimo kya Mukama kiri mu nnyumba ey'omubi: Naye awa omukisa ekifo abatuukirivu mwe babeera.
Mazima anyooma abanyoomi, Naye awa abeetoowaza ekisa.
Ab'amagezi balisikira ekitiibwa: Naye ensonyi ze ziriba okukuzibwa okw'abasirusiru.
Baana bange, muwulirenga okuyigiriza kwa kitammwe, Mutegenga amatu okumanya okutegeera:
Kubanga mbawa okuyiga okulungi; Temuvanga mu tteka lyange.
Kubanga nali mwana eri kitange, Omugonvu era eyayagalibwanga nzekka mu maaso ga mmange.
Era yanjigirizanga n'aŋŋamba nti Omutima gwo gunywezenga ebigambo byange; Kwatanga ebiragiro byange obeerenga omulamu:
Funa amagezi, funa okutegeera; Togeerabiranga so tovanga mu bigambo eby'omu kamwa kange:
Togalekanga, nago ganaakukuumanga; Ogaagalanga nago ganaakulindanga.
Amagezi kye kigambo ekisinga obukulu; kale funa amagezi: Weewaawo funanga okutegeera n'ebyo byonna bye wafunanga.
Gagulumizenga nago galikukuza: Galikutuusa mu kitiibwa, bw'onoogawambaatiranga.
Galiwa omutwe gwo engule ey'obuyonjo: Galikugabira enkuufiira ey'obulungi.
Ai mwana wange, wulira okkirizenga ebigambo byange; N'emyaka egy'obulamu bwo giriba mingi.
Naakuyigiriza ekkubo ery'amagezi; Naakuluŋŋamya mu makubo ag'obugolokofu.
Bw'onootambulanga ebigere byo tebiifundikirwenga; Era bw'onoddukanga teweesittalenga.
Nywerezanga ddala okuyigirizibwa; tokutanga: Kukwatenga; kubanga bwe bulamu bwo.
Toyingiranga mu kkubo ery'ababi, So totambuliranga mu lugendo olw'abasajja ababi.
Olwesambanga, toluyitangako; Okyukanga okuluvaamu, weeyongerenga mu maaso.
Kubanga tebeebaka wabula nga bamaze okukola akabi; N'otulo tubaggibwako wabula nga baliko be bagwisizza.
Kubanga balya emmere ey'obubi, Ne banywa omwenge ogw'okugira ekyejo.
Naye ekkubo ery'abatuukirivu liriŋŋanga omusana ogwakayakana, Ogweyongerayongera okwaka okutuusa obudde lwe butuukirira.
Ekkubo ery'ababi liriŋŋanga ekizikiza: Tebamanyi ekibeesittaza.
Mwana wange, ssangayo omwoyo eri ebigambo byange; Teganga okutu eri okwogera kwange.
Tebivanga ku maaso go; Bikuumirenga wakati mu mutima gwo.
Kubanga ebyo bwe bulamu eri abo ababiraba, Era kwe kulama eri omubiri gwabwe gwonna.
Onyiikiranga nnyo nnyini okukuumanga omutima gwo; Kubanga omwo mwe muva ensulo ez'obulamu.
Weggyengako akamwa akabambaavu, N'emimwa emikyamu ogyewalanga nnyo.
Amaaso go galuŋŋamirenga ddala, N'ebikowe byo bitunuulirenga ddala emberi yo.
Tereezanga ekkubo ery'ebigere byo, Era amagenda go gonna ganywerenga.
Tokyamiranga ku mukono ogwa ddyo newakubadde ku gwa kkono: Ggyawo ekigere kyo obutakola bubi.
Mwana wange, ssangayo omwoyo eri amagezi gange; Teganga okutu eri okutegeera kwange:
Olyoke okuumenga okuteesa, N'emimwa gyo gikwatenga okumanya.
Kubanga emimwa gy'omukazi omugenyi gitonnya omubisi gw'enjuki, N'akamwa ke kasinga amafuta obugonvu:
Naye enkomerero ey'oluvannyuma ekaawa ng'omususa, Esala ng'ekitala eky'obwogi obubiri.
Ebigere bye bikka mu kufa; Ebisinde bye bikwata amagombe;
N'okulaba talaba kkubo ttereevu ery'obulamu: Amakubo ge gasagaasagana, so takimanyi.
Kale nno, baana bange, mumpulirenga, So temuvanga mu bigambo eby'omu kamwa kange.
Ekkubo lyo limwesambire ddala, So tosembereranga luggi lwa nnyumba ye:
Olemenga okuwa abalala ekitiibwa kyo, N'emyaka gyo eri omukambwe.
Abagenyi balemenga okukkuta amaanyi go; N'emirimu gyo giremenga okubeera mu nnyumba y'omunnaggwanga;
Naawe n'onakuwala enkomerero yo ng'etuuse Ennyama yo n'omubiri gwo bwe birimalibwawo,
N'oyogera nti Nga nakyawanga okuyigirizibwa, Omutima gwange ne gunyoomanga okunenyezebwa;
So saagonderanga ddoboozi lya bayigiriza bange, So saateganga kutu kwange eri abo abanjigirizanga!
Nabulako katono okuba mu bubi bwonna Wakati mu kkuŋŋaaniro n'ekibiina.
Onyweranga amazzi mu kidiba kyo ggwe, N'amazzi agakulukuta mu luzzi lwo ggwe.
Ensulo zo zandisaasaanidde ddala, Emigga egy'amazzi ne giba mu nguudo?
Gabeereranga ddala gago wekka, So si ga bagenyi wamu naawe.
Ensulo yo ebeerenga n'omukisa; Era sanyukiranga omukazi ow'omu buvubuka bwo.
Ng'ennangaazi ekwagala n'empeewo ekusanyusa, Amabeere ge gakumalenga mu biro byonna; Era osanyukirenga bulijjo okwagala kwe.
Kubanga lwaki ggwe okusanyukiranga omukazi omugenyi, mwana wange, N'ogwa mu kifuba ky'atali wuwo?
Kubanga amakubo g'abantu gali mu maaso ga Mukama, Era atereeza eŋŋendo ze zonna.
Obutali butuukirivu bwe ye bulikwata omubi, Era alisibibwa n'emigwa egy'okwonoona kwe,
Alifa olw'okubulwa okuyigirizibwa; Era olw'obusirusiru bwe obungi aliwaba.
Mwana wange, oba nga weeyimirira muliraanwa wo, N'okubira omugenyi mu ngalo,
Ebigambo eby'omu kamwa ko bikukwasizza, Ebigambo eby'omu kamwa ko bikuteze.
Kale nno, mwana wange, kola kino weerokole, Kubanga ogudde mu mukono gwa muliraanwa wo; Genda weetoowaze otayirire muliraanwa wo.
Toganyanga maaso go kwebaka Newakubadde ebikowe byo okubongoota.
Weerokole ng'empeewo bw'eva mu mukono gw'omuyizzi, Era ng'ennyonyi bw'eva mu mukono gw'omutezi.
Genda eri enkolooto, ggwe omugayaavu; Lowooza empisa zaayo obeerenga n'amagezi:
Eyo terina mwami, Newakubadde omulabirizi newakubadde afuga,
Naye ne yeeterekera ebyayo ebyokulya mu biro eby'okukunguliramu, N'ekuŋŋaanya emmere yaayo mu mwaka.
Olituusa wa okwebakanga, ggwe omugayaavu? Oligolokoka ddi mu tulo two?
Wakyaliwo okwebaka okutono n'okubongoota okutono, N'okufunya emikono okutono okwebaka:
Bwe kityo obwavu bwo bulijja ng'omunyazi, N'okwetaaga kwo ng'omusajja akutte ebyokulwanyisa.
Omuntu ataliiko ky'agasa, omusajja ow'obutali butuukirivu; Atambula ng'alina akamwa akabambaavu;
Atemya amaaso, ayogeza bigere bye, Abagula n'engalo ze;
Obubambaavu buli mu mutima gwe, asala obubi olutata; Asiga okukyawagana nga tamanyiridde;
Ennaku z'aliraba kyeziriva zijja nga tamanyiridde; Amangu ago alimenyeka, awatali kuwonyezebwa.
Waliwo ebigambo mukaaga Mukama by'akyawa; Weewaawo, musanvu bya muzizo gy'ali:
Amaaso ag'amalala, olulimi olulimba, N'engalo eziyiwa omusaayi ogutaliiko musango;
Omutima oguyunja ebirowoozo ebibi, Ebigere ebyanguwa embiro okugoberera ettima;
Omujulirwa w'obulimba ayogera eby'obulimba, N'oyo asiga okukyawagana mu b'oluganda.
Mwana wange, okwatanga ekiragiro kya kitaawo, So tolekanga tteeka lya nnyoko:
Bisibenga ennaku zonna ku mutima gwo, Binywezenga mu bulago bwo.
Bw'onootambulanga, linaakukulemberanga; Bw'oneebakanga, linaakukuumanga: Era bw'onoozuukukanga, linaayogeranga naawe.
Kubanga etteeka ttabaaza; ekiragiro musana; N'okunenya kw'oyo akuyigiriza lye kkubo ery'obulamu:
Okukuumanga eri omukazi omubi, Eri okunyumiriza kw'olulimi lw'omugenyi.
Teweegombanga bulungi bwe mu mutima gwo; So n'ebikowe bye biremenga okukukwasa.
Kubanga olw'omukazi omwenzi omuntu afuuka mmere bumere: N'omukazi omwenzi ayigga obulamu obw'omuwendo omungi.
Omuntu ayinza okuwambaatira omuliro mu kifuba kye, Ebyambalo bye ne bitaggya?
Oba omuntu ayinza okutambulira ku manda agookya, Ebigere bye ne bitasiriira?
Bw'atyo bw'abeera ayingira eri omukazi wa munne; Buli amukomako talirema kubonerezebwa.
Abantu tebanyooma mubbi oba ng'abba Okukkusa emmeeme ye ng'alumiddwa enjala:
Naye bw'anaalabikanga, anaagattanga emirundi musanvu; Anaawangayo ebintu byonna eby'omu nnyumba ye.
Ayenda ku mukazi talina kutegeera: Ayagala okuzikiriza obulamu bwe ye ye akola bw'atyo.
Alifuna ebiwundu n'okunyoomebwa; N'ekivume kye tekirisangulibwa.
Kubanga obuggya kye kiruyi ky'omusajja; So talisaasira ku lunaku olw'okuwalanirako eggwanga.
Talissaayo mwoyo eri ekinunulo kyonna; So talinyiigulukuka newakubadde ng'owa ebirabo ebingi.
Mwana wange, okwatanga ebigambo byange, Oterekanga ebiragiro byange ewuwo.
Okwatanga ebiragiro byange obeerenga omulamu; N'etteeka lyange ng'emmunye ey'eriiso lyo.
Bisibenga ku mukono gwo; Biwandiikenga ku bipande eby'omutima gwo.
Gambanga amagezi nti Ggwe mwannyinaze; Oyitenga okutegeera ow'ekika kyammwe:
Bikukuumenga eri omukazi omugenyi, Eri omugenyi anyumiriza n'ebigambo bye.
Kubanga nalingiza mu ddirisa ery'ennyumba yange Mu mulimu omuluke ogw'omu ddirisa;
Ne ndaba mu batalina magezi, Ne ntegereza mu balenzi, Omuvubuka atalina kutegeera,
Ng'ayita mu luguudo kumpi ku mugguukiriro gwe, N'agenda mu kkubo eridda mu nnyumba ye;
Mu kizikiza, obudde nga buwungedde; Mu kizikiza eky'ekiro zigizigi.
Kale, laba, ne wamusisinkana omukazi Ng'ayambadde ebyambalo eby'omwenzi, era ow'omutima omugerengetanya.
Muyombi era mukakanyavu; Ebigere bye tebibeera mu nnyumba ye:
Oluusi aba mu nguudo, oluusi mu bifo ebigazi, Era ateegera ku buli mugguukiriro.
Awo n'amukwata n'amunywegera, N'amugamba ng'amusimbye amaaso nti
Ssaddaaka ez'ebiweebwayo olw'emirembe ziri wange; Leero mmaze okusasula obweyamo bwange.
Kyenvudde nfuluma okukusisinkana, Okunyiikira okunoonya amaaso go, era nkulabye.
Njaze ekitanda kyange n'amagodooli, N'engoye ez'amakuubo eza ppamba w’e Misiri.
Mpunyisizza bulungi ekiriri kyange N'obubaane n'omugavu n'eby'akaloosa.
Jjangu tukkute okwagala okukeesa obudde; Twesanyuse n'okwagala.
Kubanga baze tali ka, Yatambula lugendo lwa wala:
Yagenda ng'atwala ensawo eya ffeeza; Alikomawo omwezi nga gwa ggabogabo.
Amukkirizisa n'ebigambo bye ebirungi bingi, Amuwaliriza okugenda n'okwegonza okw'emimwa gye.
Amangu ago agenda amugobeberera, Ng'ente bw'egenda okusalibwa, Oba ng'amasamba bwe gagenda okukangavvula omusirusiru;
Okutuusa akasaale lwe kalifumita ekibumba kye; Ng'ennyonyi bw'eyanguwa okugwa mu kyambika, So tamanyi ng'alifiirwa obulamu bwe.
Kale nno, baana bange, mumpulirenga, Era mussengayo omwoyo eri ebigambo eby'omu kamwa kange.
Omutima gwo tegukyamiranga mu makubo ge, Towabiranga mu mpenda ze.
Kubanga yasuula bangi nga bafumitiddwa ebiwundu: Weewaawo, ababe abattibwa ggye ddene.
Ennyumba ye lye kkubo lyennyini eridda mu magombe. Nga likka mu bisenge eby'okufa.
Amagezi tegoogerera waggulu N'okutegeera tekuleeta ddoboozi lyakwo?
Enguudo we zisibuka mu kkubo Mu masaŋŋanzira we gayimirira;
Ku mabbali g'emiryango awayingirirwa mu kibuga, Abantu we bayingirira awali enzigi googerera waggulu:
Mmwe abasajja, mbakoowoola; N'eddoboozi lyange liri eri abaana b'abantu.
Mmwe abatalina magezi, mutegeerenga obukabakaba; Nammwe, abasirusiru, mubeerenga n'omutima ogutegeera.
Muwulire, kubanga naayogera ebigambo ebirungi ennyo; N'okwasama emimwa gyange kunaavaamu eby'ensonga.
Kubanga akamwa kange kanaayogera eby'amazima; N'obubi bwa muzizo eri emimwa gyange.
Ebigambo byonna eby'omu kamwa kange biri mu butuukirivu; Mu byo temuli kintu ekikyamakyama newakubadde ekyenyodde.
Byonna byangu eri oyo ategeera, Era bya nsonga eri abo abalaba okumanya.
Mukkirize okuyigiriza kwange so si ffeeza; N'okumanya okukira zaabu ennonde.
Kubanga amagezi gasinga amayinja amatwakaavu; N'ebintu byonna ebiyinzika okwegombebwa tebyenkanyankanyizibwa nago.
Nze amagezi nfudde obukabakaba okuba ennyumba yange Era nnoonya okumanya n'okuteesa.
Okutya Mukama kwe kukyawa obubi; Amalala n'essukuti n'ekkubo ebbi N'akamwa akabambaavu bye nkyawa.
Okuteesa kwange n'okumanya okutuufu: Nze ndi kutegeera; nnina amaanyi.
Ku bwange bakabaka bafuga, Abalangira ne bateeka eby'obutuukiruvu.
Ku bwange abalangira bafuga, N'abakungu, abalamuzi bonna ab'oku nsi:
Njagala abo abanjagala; N’abo abanyiikira okunnoonya balindaba.
Obugagga n’ekitiibwa biri nange; Wewaawo, obugagga obw’enkalakkalira n’obutuukirivu.
Ebibala byange bisinga zaabu obulungi, weewaawo, zaabu ennungi; N'amagoba gange gakira ffeeza ennonde.
Ntambulira mu kkubo ery'obutuukirivu, Wakati mu mpenda ez'okusala emisango:
Ndyoke mpe abo abanjagala okusikira ebintu, Era njijuze amawanika gaabwe.
Mukama yali nange ekkubo lye we lyasookera, Okusooka emirimu gye egy'edda.
Nateekebwawo okuva emirembe n'emirembe, okuva ku lubereberye, Ensi nga tennabaawo.
Nga tewannabaawo buziba, nazaalibwa; Ensulo ezijjudde amazzi nga tezinnabaawo.
Ensozi nga tezinnaba kussibwawo, Nasooka obusozi okuzaalibwa:
Ye nga tannatonda nsi newakubadde ennimiro, Newakubadde enfuufu ey'ensi eyasooka.
Bwe yanyweza eggulu, nze naliyo: Bwe yakulunga amaaso g'obuziba:
Bwe yanyweza eggulu waggulu: Ensulo ez'ennyanja bwe zaafuuka ez'amaanyi: omubi yeetonnyezaako ebbala.
Bwe yawa ennyanja ensalo yaayo, Amazzi galemenga okusobya ekiragiro kye: Bwe yalamba emisingi gy'ensi:
Kale nze nga ndi awo gy'ali ng'omukoza: Era bulijjo yansanyukiranga, Nga njaguliza bulijjo mu maaso ge;
Nga nsanyukira ensi ye ebeerekamu; N'essanyu lyange lyali n'abaana b'abantu.
Kale nno, baana bange, mumpulirenga: Kubanga balina omukisa abakwata amakubo gange.
Muwulirenga okuyigirizibwa mubenga n’amagezi, So temugagaananga.
Alina omukisa omuntu ampulira, Ng'atunuulira bulijjo ku nzigi zange, Ng'alinda awali emifuubeeto gy'enzigi zange.
Kubanga buli alaba nze alaba bulamu, Era alifuna okuganja eri Mukama.
Naye oyo annyonoona asobya obulamu bwe ye: Bonna abakyawa nze baagala okufa.
Amagezi gazimbye ennyumba yaago, Gatemye empagi zaago musanvu:
Gasse ensolo zaago; gatabudde omwenge gwago; Era gategese emmeeza yaago.
Gasindise abawala baago, googerera waggulu. Ku bifo eby'omu kibuga ebisinga obugulumivu,
Nti Buli atalina magezi akyamire muno: Oyo abulwa okutegeera gamugamba nti
Mujje mulye ku mmere yange, Era munywe ku mwenge gwe ntabudde.
Mulekenga, mmwe abatalina magezi, mubeerenga abalamu; Era mutambulirenga mu kkubo ery'okutegeera.
Anenya omukudaazi yeeswaza: N'oyo abuulirira omubi yeetonnyezaako ebbala.
Tobuuliriranga mukudaazi aleme okukukyawa: Buuliriranga ow'amagezi, anaakwagalanga.
Yigirizanga ow'amagezi, aneeyongeranga okuba n'amagezi: Yigirizanga omutuukirivu, aneeyongeranga okuyita.
Mu kutya Mukama amagezi mwe gasookera: N'okumanya oyo Omutukuvu kwe kutegeera.
Kubanga ku bwange ennaku zo ziryongerwa, N’emyaka egy’obulamu bwo girisukkirizibwa.
Oba nga olina amagezi, weebeera n’amagezi wekka: Era bw’onoonyoomanga, kuliba ku ggwe wekka.
Omukazi omusirisiru aleekaana; Talina magezi, so taliiko ky'amanyi.
Era atuula ku mulyango gw'ennyumba ye, Ku ntebe mu bifo eby'omu kibuga ebigulumivu,
Okuyita abo abayitawo, Abakwatira ddala amakubo gaabwe,
Nti Buli atalina magezi akyamire muno: N'oyo abulwa okutegeera amugamba nti
Amazzi amabbe ge gawooma, N'emmere eriirwa mu kyama ye esanyusa.
Naye tamanyi ng'abafu bali eyo: Ng'abagenyi be bali mu buziba bw'emagombe.
Engero za Sulemaani. Omwana ow'amagezi asanyusa kitaawe: Naye omwana omusirusiru anakuwaza nnyina.
Obugagga obw'obubi tebuliiko kye bugasa: Naye obutuukirivu buwonya mu kufa.
Mukama taalekenga mmeeme ya mutuukirivu okufa enjala: Naye okwegomba kw'ababi akusindika eri.
Ayavuwala oyo akola n'omukono oguddiridde: Naye omukono gw'abanyiikivu guleeta obugagga.
Akungulira mu kyeya mwana wa magezi: Naye oyo eyeebakira mu biro eby'okukunguliramu ye mwana akwasa ensonyi.
Emikisa giba ku mutwe gw'omutuukirivu: Naye ekyejo kibikka ku kamwa k'ababi.
Ekijjukizo ky'omutuukirivu kirina omukisa: Naye erinnya ly'ababi lirivunda.
Alina omutima ogw'amagezi anakkirizanga ebiragiro: Naye omubuyabuya aligwa.
Atambulira mu bugolokofu ye atambula emirembe: Naye akyamya amakubo ge alimanyibwa.
Atemya eriiso eleeta ennaku: Naye omusirusiru omubuyabuya aligwa.
Akamwa k'omutuukirivu nsulo ya bulamu: Naye ekyejo kibikka ku kamwa k'ababi.
Okukyawa kuleeta ennyombo: Naye okwagala kubikka ku byonoono byonna.
Mu mimwa gy'oyo alina okwawula mulabikamu amagezi: Naye omuggo gwa mabega g'oyo abulwa okutegeera.
Ab'amagezi batereka okumanya: Naye akamwa k'omusirusiru kwe kuzikirira okutavaawo.
Ebintu eby'omugagga kye kibuga kye eky'amaanyi: Abaavu okuzikirira kwabwe bwavu bwabwe.
Omulimu ogw'omutuukirivu guleeta bulamu; Ekyengera eky'omubi kireeta kwonoona.
Oyo ali mu kkubo ery'obulamu assaayo omwoyo eri okubuulirirwa: Naye oyo aleka okunenyezebwa akyama.
Oyo akisa okukyawa wa mimwa gya bulimba; N'oyo awaayiriza musirusiru.
Mu lufulube lw'ebigambo temubula kusobya: Naye oyo aziyiza emimwa gye akola eby'amagezi.
Olulimi lw'omutuukirivu ffeeza nnonde: Omutima gw'ababi tegugasa nnyo.
Emimwa gy'omutuukirivu giriisa bangi: Naye abasirusiru bafa olw'okubulwa okutegeera.
Omukisa gwa Mukama gwe gugaggawaza, So tagatta buyinike bwonna wamu nagwo.
Okukola obubi muzannyo gwa musirusiru: Era bwe gatyo amagezi bwe gabeera eri omuntu alina okutegeera.
Omubi ky'atya kirimujjira: N'ekyo abatuukirivu kye beegomba balikiweebwa.
Empewo ez'akazimu bwe ziyita, kale omubi nga takyaliwo: Naye omutuukirivu musingi gwa lubeerera.
Ng'omwenge omukaatuufu bwe gugira amannyo, era ng'omukka bwe gugira amaaso, N'omugayaavu bw'agira bw'atyo abo abamutuma.
Okutya Mukama kuwangaaza: Naye emyaka gy'ababi girisalibwako.
Essuubi ery'abatuukirivu liriba ssanyu: Naye okusuubira kw'ababi kulizikirira.
Ekkubo lya Mukama kigo eri omugolokofu; Naye kuzikirira eri abo abakola ebitali bya butuukirivu.
Omutuukirivu tajjululwenga ennaku zonna: Naye ababi tebalibeera mu nsi.
Akamwa k'omutuukirivu kazaala amagazi: Naye olulimi olubambaavu lulimalibwawo.
Emimwa gy'omutuukirivu gigaanyi ebikkirizibwa: Naye omumwa gw'ababi gwogera bubambaavu.
Eminzaani ey'obulimba ya muzizo eri Mukama: Naye ekipima ekituufu ky'asanyukira.
Amalala lwe gajja, lwe wajja n'ensonyi: Naye amagezi gaba n'abeetoowaza.
Obutayonoona obw'abagolokofu bulibaluŋŋamya: Naye obubambaavu bw'abo abasala enkwe bulibazikiriza.
Obugagga tebuliiko kye bugasa ku lunaku olw'obusungu: Naye obutuukirivu buwonya mu kufa.
Obutuukirivu bw'oyo eyatuukirira bunaaluŋŋamyanga ekkubo lye: Naye omubi aligwa olw'obubi bwe ye.
Obutuukirivu obw'abagolokofu bulibawonya: Abo abasala enkwe balikwasibwa n'ettima lyabwe bo.
Omuntu omubi bw'afanga, okusuubira kwe kuzikiriranga: N'essuubi ery'obutali butuukikirivu libula.
Omutuukirivu awonyezebwa mu nnaku, Omubi n'adda mu kifo kye.
Atamanyi Katonda azikiriza munne n'akamwa ke: Naye abatuukirivu baliwonyezebwa olw'okumanya.
Abatuukirivu bwe balaba ebirungi, ekibuga kisanyuka: Era ababi bwe babula, wabaawo okuleekaana.
Omukisa ogw'abagolokofu gwe gugulumiza ekibuga: Naye akamwa k'ababi ke kakisuula.
Anyooma munne abulwa amagezi: Naye omuntu alina okutegeera asirika.
Atambulatambula ng'alyolyoma abikkula ebyama: Naye oyo alina omwoyo omwesigwa akisa ekigambo.
Okuluŋŋamya okw'amagezi nga kubuze, abantu bagwa: Naye mu bateesa ebigambo abangi mwe muli emirembe.
Eyeeyimirira oyo gw'atamanyi alibalagalwa: Naye akyawa obuyima anaabanga wa nkalakkalira.
Omukazi ow'ekisa aguguba n'ekitiibwa: N'abasajja ab'amawaggali baguguba n'obugagga.
Asaasira akola bulungi emmeeme ye ye: Naye omukambwe ateganya omubiri gwe ye.
Omubi afuna empeera emulimbalimba: Naye oyo asiga obutuukirivu aba n'empeera ey'enkalakkalira.
Anywerera mu butuukirivu ye alituuka mu bulamu: N'oyo agoberera obubi yetta yekka.
Abo abalina omutima omukyamu ba muzizo eri Mukama: Naye abo abalina ekkubo eryatuukirira b'asanyukira.
Omukono newakubadde nga gwegatta n'omukono, omuntu omubi taliwona kubonerezebwa: Naye ezzadde ery'abatuukirivu liriwonyezebwa.
Ng'ekyobuyonjo ekya zaabu ekiri mu nnyindo y'embizzi, Bw'atyo bw'abeera omukazi omulungi atalina kuteesa.
Abatuukirivu kye beegomba birungi bisa: Naye ababi kye basuubira busungu.
Wabaawo asaasaanya ne yeeyongera nate okwala; Era wabaawo akodowala okusinga bwe kigwana, naye kireeta kwetaaga bwetaazi.
Emmeeme egabagaba eneegejjanga: N'oyo afukirira amazzi, naye alifukirirwa yennyini.
Amma eŋŋaano, abantu balimukolimira: Naye omukisa gunaabanga ku mutwe gw'oyo agitunda.
Anyiikira okunoonyanga ebirungi, anoonyanga n'okuganja: Naye akenneenya ettima, linaamujjiranga.
Eyeesiga obugagga bwe aligwa: Naye abatuukirivu banaayeranga ng'amalagala amabisi.
Ateganya ennyumba ye ye alisikira empewo: N'omusirisuru aliba muddu w'oyo alina omutima ogw'amagezi.
Ebibala by'omutuukirivu muti gwa bulamu: N'oyo alina amagezi afuna emmeeme z'abantu.
Laba, omutuukirivu aliweebwa empeera mu nsi: Omubi n'omwonoonyi tebalisinga nnyo?
Ayagala okubuulirirwa ayagala okumanya: Naye oyo akyawa okunenyezebwa aliŋŋanga ensolo.
Omuntu omulungi anaaweebwanga Mukama ekisa: Naye omuntu ow'enkwe embi alimusalira omusango okumusinga.
Omuntu taanywezebwenga lwa bubi: Naye emmizi gy'abatuukirivu tegijjululwenga ennaku zonna.
Omukazi eyeegendereza ngule eri bba: Naye aswaza kivundu mu magumba ge.
Ebirowoozo eby'abatuukirivu bya nsonga: Naye ababi bye bateesa bulimba.
Ebigambo eby'ababi bya kutega musaayi: Naye akamwa k'abagolokofu kalibawonya.
Ababi bameggebwa ne babula: Naye ennyumba ey'abatuukirivu eriyimirira.
Omuntu alisiimibwa ng'amagezi ge bwe gali: Naye oyo alina omutima omukyamu alinyoomebwa.
Oyo atayitibwa ka buntu, era alina omuddu, Asinga oyo eyessaamu ekitiibwa era abulwa eby'okulya.
Omuntu omutuukirivu alowooza obulamu bw'ensolo ye: Naye okusaasira kw'ababi kukambwe.
Alima ensi ye aliba n'emmere nnyingi: Naye agoberera abataliiko kye bagasa abuliddwa okutegeera.
Omubi yeegomba ekitimba ky'abasajja ab'ekyejo: Naye ekikolo eky'abatuukirivu kibala ebibala.
Mu kusobya kw'emimwa mulimu ekyambika eri omuntu ow'ekyejo:
Omuntu alikkuta ebirungi olw'ebibala eby'akamwa ke: N'ebikolwa eby'emikono gy'omuntu alibisasulibwa.
Ekkubo ery'omusirusiru ddungi mu maaso ge ye: Naye ow'amagezi awulira okuweererwa ebigambo.
Okweraliikirira kw'omusirusiru kumanyibwa mangu ago: Naye omuntu omutegeevu akisa ensonyi.
Ayatula eby'amazima ayolesa obutuukirivu, Naye omujulirwa ow'obulimba ayolesa obukuusa.
Wabaawo ayogera ng'ayanguyiriza ng'okufumita okw'ekitala: Naye olulimi lw'ab'amagezi kwe kulaama.
Omumwa ogw'amazima gunaanywezebwanga emirembe gyonna: Naye olulimi olulimba lwa kaseera buseera.
Okudyeka kuli mu mitima gy'abo abateesa obubi: Naye abateesa emirembe baba n'essanyu.
Omutuukirivu talibaako kabi k'aliraba: Naye ab'ekyejo balikkuta obubi.
Emimwa egirimba gya muzizo eri Mukama: Naye abo abakola eby'amazima b'asanyukira.
Omuntu omutegeevu akisa okumanya: Naye omutima gw'abasirusiru gulaalika obusirusiru.
Omukono gw'abanyiikivu gulifuga: Naye omugayaavu balimukoza omulimu ogw'obuddu.
Ennaku bwe ziba mu mutima gw'omuntu zigukutamya; Naye ekigambo ekirungi kigusanyusa.
Omutuukirivu aba musaale eri munne: Naye ekkubo ery'ababi libawabya.
Omuntu omugayaavu tayokya ekyo ky'akutte ng'ayigga; Naye ebintu eby'omuwendo omungi eby'abantu biba bya munyiikivu.
Mu kkubo ery'obutuukirivu mwe muli obulamu; Ne mu luwenda lw'abo temuli kufa.
Omwana ow'amagezi awulira okuyigiriza kwa kitaawe: Naye omunyoomi tawulira kunenyezebwa.
Omuntu anaalyanga ebirungi olw'ebibala eby'akamwa ke: Naye emmeeme ey'abasala enkwe eneeryanga kugirirwa kyejo.
Akuuma akamwa ke anyweza obulamu bwe: Naye ayasama ennyo akamwa ke aliba n'okuzikirira.
Emmeeme ey'omugayaavu yeegomba n'eteba na kintu: Naye emmeeme ey'abanyiikivu eneegejjanga.
Omuntu omutuukirivu akyawa obulimba: Naye omuntu omubi mugwagwa, era akwatibwa ensonyi.
Obutuukirivu bukuuma oyo akwata ekkubo eggolokofu: Naye ekyejo kisuula oyo alina ebibi.
Wabaawo eyeegaggawaza, naye nga talina kintu: Wabaawo eyeeyavuwaza, naye ng'alina obugagga bungi.
Obugagga bwe bwe bununula obulamu bw'omuntu: Naye omwavu, tawulira kukanga kwonna.
Omusana ogw'abatuukirivu gusanyuka: Naye ettabaaza ey'ababi erizikizibwa.
Amalala galeeta okuwakana okwereere: Naye amagezi gaba n'abo abateesa obulungi.
Obugagga obufunibwa olw'ebigambo ebitaliimu bulikendeezebwa: Naye oyo akuaanya ng'akola emirimu aliba n'okwala.
Essuubi erirwawo lisinduukiriza emmeeme: Naye ekyegombebwa bwe kijja kiba muti gwa bulamu.
Buli anyooma ekigambo yeereetako okuzikirira: Naye oyo atya ekiragiro aliweebwa empeera.
Etteeka ery'omugezigezi nsulo ya bulamu, Okuva mu byambika eby'okufa.
Okutegeera okulungi kuleeta okuganja: Naye ekkubo ery'abasala enkwe bbi.
Buli muntu omutegeevu akola emirimu n'okumanya: Naye omusirusiru ayaliira obusirusiru.
Omubaka ow'ekyejo agwa mu bubi: Naye omutume omwesigwa kwe kulaama.
Obwavu n'ensonyi biriba by'oyo agaana okubuulirirwa: Naye assaayo omwoyo eri okuneenyezebwa alissibwamu ekitiibwa.
Ekyegombebwa bwe kituukirira kiwoomera emmeeme: Naye okuva mu bubi kwa muzizo eri abasirusiru.
Otambulanga n'abantu ab'amagezi, naawe oliba n'amagezi: Naye munnaabwe w'abasirusiru alibalagalwa.
Obubi bugoberera abalina ebibi: Naye abatuukirivu balisasulibwa ebirungi.
Omuntu omulungi alekera obusika abaana b'abaana be: N'obugagga bw'oyo alina ebibi buterekerwa omutuukirivu.
Mu nnimiro ez'abaavu mulimu emmere nnyingi: Naye wabaawo azikirizibwa olw'obutagoberera nsonga.
Atakwata muggo gwe akyawa omwana we: Naye oyo amwagala amukangavvula ebiro nga bikyali.
Omutuukirivu alya, emmeeme ye n’ekkuta: Naye olubuto lw'ababi lulirumwa enjala.
Buli mukazi ow'amagezi azimba ennyumba ye. Naye omusirusiru agyabya n'emikono gye ye.
Atambulira mu bugolokofu bwe atya Mukama: Naye akyamakyama mu makubo ge amunyooma.
Mu kamwa k'omusirusiru mulimu omuggo ogw'amalala: Naye emimwa gy'ab'amagezi ginaabakuumanga.
Eteri nte ekisibo kiba kirongoofu: Naye amaanyi g'ente galeeta okwala kungi.
Omujulirwa omwesigwa talimba: Naye omujulirwa ow'obulimba ayogera eby'okuwaayiriza.
Anyooma anoonya amagezi n'atagalaba: Naye okumanya kwangu eri oyo alina okutegeera.
Yingira mu masso g'omusirusiru, Toolabe ku ye mimwa gya kumanya.
Okutegeera ekkubo lye ge magezi g'omutegeevu: Naye abasirusiru obusirusiru bwabwe kulimba.
Abasirusiru bakudaalira omusango: Naye mu bagolokofu mulimu ekisa.
Omutima gumanya okulumwa kwagwo; So n'omugenyi teyeetabula mu ssanyu lyagwo.
Ennyumba ey'ababi erisuulibwa: Naye eweema ey'abagolokofu eneebanga n'omukisa.
Waliwo ekkubo omuntu ly'ayita eddungi, Naye enkomerero yaalyo ge makubo ag'okufa.
Ne bwe guseka omutima gunakuwala; N'enkomerero y'okuseka buyinike.
Adda ennyuma mu mutima gwe alikkuta amakubo ge ye: N'omuntu omulungi alikkuta ye yennyini.
Atalina magezi akkiriza buli kigambo kyonna: Naye omuntu omutegeevu akebera nnyo amagenda ge.
Omuntu ow'amagezi atya n'ava mu bubi: Naye omusirusiru aba n'ettitimbuli, era yeeyinula.
Ayanguwa okusunguwala alikola eby'obusirusiru: N'omuntu asala enkwe embi akyayibwa.
Abatalina magezi basikira obusirusiru: Naye abategeevu bassibwako engule kwe kumanya.
Ababi bakutamira abalungi; N'ab'ekyejo awali emiryango egy'abatuukirivu.
Omwavu ne munne amukyawa: Naye omugagga alina emikwano mingi:
Anyooma munne ayonoona: Naye asaasira abaavu alina omukisa.
Abagunja obubi tebawaba? Naye okusaasirwa n'amazima binaabanga byabwe abagunja obulungi.
Omulimu gwonna guliko kye gugasa: Naye okubuyabuya kw'emimwa kwavuwaza bwavuwaza.
Obugagga bwabwe ye ngule ey'ab'amagezi: Naye obusirusiru bw'abasirusiru busirusiru bwereere.
Omujulirwa ow'amazima awonya emmeeme z'abantu: Naye aleeta eby'obulimba akyamya.
Mu kutya Mukama mulimu okuguma ennyo omwoyo: N'abaana be baliba n'obuddukiro.
Okutya Mukama nsulo ya bulamu, Okuva mu byambika eby'okufa.
Mu lufulube lw'abantu mwe muli ekitiibwa kya kabaka: Naye okubulwa abantu kwe kuzikirira kw'omulangira:
Alwawo okusunguwala alina okutegeera kungi: Naye alina omwoyo ogwanguyiriza agulumiza obusirusiru.
Omutima omutuufu bwe bulamu obw'omubiri: Naye obuggya kwe kuvunda kw'amagumba.
Ajooga omwavu avuma Omutonzi we: Naye asaasira oyo eyeetaaga amussaamu ekitiibwa.
Omubi asindikibwa wansi mu kwonoona kwe: Naye omutuukirivu alina essuubi mu kufa kwe:
Amagezi gabeera mu mutima gw'oyo alina okutegeera: Naye ekiri ku kitundu eky'abasirusiru eky'omunda kimanyisibwa.
Obutuukirivu bugulumiza eggwanga; Naye ekibi kivumisa eggwanga lyonna.
Omuddu akola eby'amagezi ye aganja eri kabaka: Naye obusungu bwe bunaabanga eri oyo akwasa ensonyi.
Okuddamu n'eggonjebwa kukyusa ekuruyi: Naye ekigambo eky'ekkayu kisaanuula obusungu.
Olulimi lw'ab'amagezi lwogera okumanya nga bwe kisaana: Naye akamwa k'abasirusiru kayiwa obusirusiru.
Amaaso ga Mukama gaba mu buli kifo, Nga galabirira ababi n'abalungi.
Olulimi oluwonya muti gwa bulamu: Naye bwe luba n'obukyamu, omwoyo gumenyeka.

Omuntu eyeebinise omusaayi ogwa buli muntu yenna Aliddukira mu bunnya; tewabangawo muntu amuziyiza.
Buli atambula n'obugolokofu aliwonyezebwa: Naye ow'amakubo amakyamu aligwa mangu ago.
Alima ensi ye aliba n'emmere nnyingi: Naye agoberera abantu abataliiko kye bagasa aliba n'obwavu obulimumala.
Omuntu omwesigwa aliba n'okwebazibwa kungi: Naye ayanguwa okugaggawala taliwona kubonerezebwa.
Okusosola mu bantu si kulungi: Newakubadde omuntu okusobya olw'akamere obumere.
Alina eriiso ebbi ayanguwa okugoberera obugagga, So tamanyi ng'okwetaaga kulimutuukako.
Anenya omuntu oluvannyuma alyeyongera okuganja Okusinga oyo anyumiriza n'olulimi.
Buli anyaga kitaawe oba nnyina n'ayogera nti Si musango; Oyo ye munne w'omuzikiriza.
Ow'omwoyo ogw'omululu aleeta oluyombo: Naye eyeesiga Mukama aligejja.
Eyeesiga omutima gwe ye musirisiru: Naye atambula n'amagezi ye aliwonyezebwa.
Agabira omwavu teyeetaagenga: Naye akisa amaaso ge anaabanga n'ebikolimo bingi.
Ababi bwe bagolokoka, abantu beekweka: Naye bwe bazikirira, abatuukirivu beeyongera.
Omuntu akakanyaza ensingo ye bw'anenyezebwa emirundi emingi Alimenyeka nga tamanyiridde awatali kuwonyezebwa.
Abatuukirivu bwe beeyongera, abantu basanyuka: Naye omuntu omubi bw'afuga, abantu basinda.
Buli ayagala amagezi asanyusa kitaawe: Naye oyo abeera n'abakazi abenzi amalawo ebintu bye.
Kabaka anyweza ensi lwa kusala misango: Naye asolooza enguzi agisuula.
Omuntu anyumiriza munne Ategera ebigere bye ekitimba.
Mu kusobya kw'omuntu omubi mulimu ekyambika: Naye omutuukirivu ayimba n'asanyuka.
Omutuukirivu yeetegereza ensonga ey'abaavu: Naye omubi talina kutegeera okugimanya.
Abantu abanyooma basasamaza ekibuga: Naye abantu ab'amagezi bakyusa obusungu ne buvaawo.
Omuntu ow'amagezi bw'aba n'empaka n'omuntu omusirusiru, Oba nga asunguwala oba nga aseka, tewaliba kuwummula.
Abayagala omusaayi bakyawa oyo eyatuukirira: N'omugolokofu banoonya obulamu bwe.
Omusirusiru ayatula obusungu bwe bwonna: Naye omuntu ow'amagezi abuziyiza n'abukkakkanya.
Omukulu bw'awulira eby'obulimba, Abaddu be bonna baba babi.
Omwavu n'omujoozi balabagana: Mukama ayakira amaaso gaabwe bombi.
Kabaka asalira abaavu emisango n'obwesigwa, Entebe ye eneenywezebwanga emirembe gyonna.
Omuggo n'okunenya bireeta amagezi: Naye omwana gwe balekera awo akwasa nnyina ensonyi.
Ababi bwe beeyongera, okusobya kweyongera: Naye abatuukirivu balitunuulira okugwa kwabwe.
Buuliriranga omwana wo, anaakuwanga okuwummula; Weewaawo, anaasanyusanga emmeeme yo.
Awatali kwolesebwa, abantu basuula okuziyizibwa: Naye akwata amateeka alina omukisa.
Omuddu taganya kubuulirirwa lwa bigambo: Kubanga ne bw'ategeera talissaayo mwoyo.
Olaba omuntu ayanguyiriza ebigambo bye? Omusirusiru asuubirwa okukira ye.
Alera omuddu we nga yeekanasa okuva mu buto bwe Alimufuukira omwana ku nkomerero.
Omuntu ow'obusungu aleeta ennyombo, N'ow'ekiruyi okusobya kwe kuba kungi nnyo nnyini.
Amalala ag'omuntu galimutoowaza: Naye alina omwoyo ogwetoowaza alifuna ekitiibwa.
Buli assa ekimu n'omubi akyawa obulamu bwe ye: Awulira okulayizibwa n'atabaako ky'ayogera.
Okutya abantu kuleeta ekyambika: Naye buli eyeesiga Mukama anaabanga mirembe.
Bangi abaagala okuganja eri omukulu: Naye omusango gw'omuntu guva eri Mukama.
Omuntu atali wa nsonga wa muzizo eri abatuukirivu: N'oyo akwata ekkubo eggolokofu wa muzizo eri ababi.
Ebigambo bya Aguli mutabani wa Yake; ebyalagulwa. Omusajja agamba Isyeri, Isyeri ne Ukali;
Nti Mazima nninga ensolo okusinga omuntu yenna, So sirina kutegeera kwa muntu:
So siyiganga magezi, So sirina kumanya kw'oyo Omutukuvu.

Ani eyali alinnye mu ggulu n'akka? Ani eyali akuŋŋaanyizza empewo mu bikonde bye? Ani eyali asibye amazzi mu kyambalo kye? Ani eyali anywezezza enkomerero zonna ez'ensi. Erinnya lye ye ani, n'omwana we erinnya lye ye ani, oba ng'omanyi?
Buli kigambo kya Katonda kikemebwa: Aba ngabo eri abo abamwesiga.
Toyongeranga ku bigambo bye, Aleme okukunenyanga naawe n'olabika ng'omulimba.
Nkusabye ebigambo bibiri; Tonnyima nga sinnafa:
Ggyangawo ebigambo ebitaliimu n'eby'obulimba bibe wala nange: Tompanga bwavu newakubadde obugagga; Ndisanga emmere gye nneetaaga:
Nneme okukkutanga ne nkwegaana ne njogera nti Mukama ye ani? Era nnemenga okuba omwavu ne nziba, Ne njogera bubi erinnya lya Katonda wange.
Towaayirizanga muddu eri mukama we, Alemenga okukukolimira naawe n'olowoozebwa ng'ozizza omusango.
Waliwo abantu abakolimira kitaabwe; So tebasabira nnyaabwe omukisa.
Waliwo abantu ababa abalongoofu mu maaso gaabwe bo, Era naye tebanaazibwako empitambi yaabwe.
Waliwo abantu, amaaso gaabwe nga malalambavu! N'ebikowe byabwe bigulumizibwa.
Waliwo abantu amannyo gaabwe bitala, n'amasongezo gaabwe bwambe, Okulya abaavu okubamalawo ku nsi, n'abeetaaga mu bantu.
Ekinoso kirina abawala baakyo babiri aboogerera waggulu nti Mpa, mpa. Waliwo ebintu bisatu ebitakkuta ennaku zonna, Weewaawo, ebina ebitayogera nti Lekera awo:
Amagombe; n'olubuto olugumba; N'ensi etekkuta mazzi; N'omuliro ogutayogera nti Lekera awo.
Eriiso erikudaalira kitaawe, Ne linyooma okugondera nnyina, Bannamuŋŋoona ab'omu kiwonvu baliriggyamu, N'empungu ziririrya.
Waliwo ebigambo bisatu eby'ekitalo ebinnema, Weewaawo, ebina bye ssimanyi:
Ekkubo ery'empungu mu bbanga; Ekkubo ery'omusota ku lwazi; Ekkubo ery'eryato wakati mu nnyanja; N'ekkubo ery'omusajja n'omuwala.
Bwe lityo bwe libeera ekkubo ery'omukazi omwenzi; Alya n'asangula ku mimwa gye, N'ayogera nti Siriiko bubi bwe nkoze.
Ensi ekankanira ebigambo bisatu, Era ebina by'eteyinza kugumiikiriza:
Omuddu bw'aba kabaka; N'omusirusiru bw'akkuta emmere;
Omukazi omugwagwa bw'afumbirwa; N'omuzaana asikira mugole we.
Waliwo ebintu bina ebitono ku nsi, Naye birina amagezi mangi nnyo nnyini:
Enkolooto lye ggwanga eritalina maanyi, Naye zeeterekera emmere yaazo mu kyeya;
Obumyu buntu bunafu, Naye bwezimbira ennyumba zaabwo mu mayinja;
Enzige tezirina kabaka, Naye zitabaala zonna bibiina bibiina;
Omunya gukwata n'engalo zaagwo, Naye gubeera mu mayumba ga bakabaka.
Waliwo ebintu bisatu ebyesimba obulungi mu kutambula kwabyo, Weewaawo, ebina ebyesimba obulungi mu kugenda:
Empologoma esinga ensolo zonna amaanyi, So tewali gy'esegulira yonna;
Embwa enjizzi; era n'embuzi ennume; Ne kabaka atagolokokerwako.
Oba ng'okoze eby'obusirusiru nga weegulumiza, Oba ng'olowoozezza obubi, Teekanga omukono gwo ku kamwa ko.
Kubanga okusunda amata kuleeta omuzigo, N'okunyigiriza ennyindo kuleeta omusaayi: N'okunyigiriza kw'obusungu bwe kutyo kuleeta oluyombo.
Ebigambo bya kabaka Lemweri; ebyalagulwa nnyina bye yamuyigiriza.
Kiki, mwana wange? era kiki, ai mwana w'olubuto lwange? Era kiki, ai mwana w'obweyamo bwange?
Towanga bakazi amaanyi go, Newakubadde amakubo go eri ekyo ekizikiriza bakabaka.
Si kwa bakabaka, ai Lemweri, si kwa bakabaka okunywanga omwenge; So si kwa balangira okwogeranga nti Ekitamiiza kiri ludda wa?
Balemenga okunywa ne beerabira amateeka, Ne banyoola omusango gw'omuntu yenna abonyaabonyezebwa.
Mumuwenga ekitamiiza oyo ayagala okufa, N'omwenge oyo alina emmeeme eriko obuyinike:
Anywenga yeerabirenga obwavu bwe, Alemenga okujjukira nate ennaku ze.
Yasamanga akamwa ko olwa kasiru, Okuwoza ensonga y'abo bonna abalekebwa nga tebalina bannaabwe.
Yasamanga akamwa ko osalenga emisango egy'ensonga, Osalirenga emisango omwavu n'eyeetaaga.
Omukazi omwegendereza ani ayinza okumulaba? Kubanga omuwendo gwe gusinga wala amayinja amatwakaavu.
Omutima gwa bba gumwesiga, So taabulwenga magoba.
Amukola bulungi so si bubi Ennaku zonna ez'obulamu bwe.
Anoonya ebyoya by'endiga ne ppamba, N'akola emirimu n'engalo ze n’essanyu.
Ali ng'amaato ag'abasuubuzi; Emmere ye agiggya wala.
Era agolokoka nga bukyali bwa kiro, N'awa ab'omu nnyumba ye ebyokulya, N'agabira abawala be emirimu gyabwe.
Alowooza ennimiro n'agiguia: Asimba olusuku olw'emizabbibu n'ebibala eby'emikono gye.
Yeesiba n'amaanyi, N'anyweza emikono gye.
Alaba ng'obuguzi bwe bulimu ettunzi: Ettabaaza ye tezikira kiro.
Ateeka engalo ze ku muggo ogubaako ppamba, Emikono gye ne gikwata akati akalanga.
Ayanjululiza omwavu omukono gwe: Weewaawo, agololera emikono gye oyo eyeetaaga.
Omuzira tagutiira ab'omu nnyumba ye; Kubanga ab'omu nnyumba ye bonna bambadde olugoye olumyufu.
Yeekolera amagodooli; Ebyambalo bye bafuta nnungi n'olugoye olw'effulungu.
Bba amanyibwa mu miryango, Bw'atuula mu bakadde ab'ensi.
Atunga ebyambalo ebya bafuta n'abitunda; N'awa omusuubuzi enkoba.
Amaanyi n'okutiibwa bye byambalo bye; Era asekerera ebiro ebigenda okujja.
Ayasama akamwa ke n'amagezi; N'etteeka ery'ekisa liba ku lulimi lwe.
Alabirira nnyo empisa ez'ab'omu nnyumba ye, So talya mmere ya kugayaala.
Abaana be bagolokoka ne bamuyita wa mukisa; Ne bba, n'amutendereza ng'ayogera nti
Abawala bangi abaakola eby'okwegendereza, Naye ggwe obasinga bonna.
Okuganja kulimba n'obulungi tebuliiko kye bugasa: Naye omukazi atya Mukama ye anaatenderezebwanga.
Mumuwenga ku bibala eby'emikono gye; N'emirimu gye gimutenderezenga mu miryango.
